summary: Endless browser space-runner with real Three.js bloom, hand-written particles and an audio engine synthesized live in Web Audio - not one sound file in the repo. Skim an obstacle without touching it and take the near-miss bonus. A daily run seeded from the UTC date deals every player the same obstacles. 0.7 MB, no build step.
